card.name: Currulao
card.profile: An Afro-descendant marimba dance-music of Colombia's South Pacific coast (Choco, Valle del Cauca, Cauca, Narino) and Ecuador's Esmeraldas, in 6/8 with interlocking polyrhythms and call-and-response vocals (Smithsonian Folklife; Music of Colombia, Wikipedia). The ensemble centers on the marimba de chonta, cununo drums, bombo and guasa shaker; a courtship dance with handkerchief play and ritual links to arrullos and alabaos.
card.insight: Currulao is integral to UNESCO's 'Marimba music, traditional chants and dances from the Colombia South Pacific region and Esmeraldas Province of Ecuador' (file 01099): inscribed via Decision 5.COM 6.8 (Nairobi, 2010) and extended on 2 December 2015 in Windhoek to include Ecuador (UNESCO ICH).

observation.setting: indoor stage performance with dark curtains, red side panels, and overhead stage lighting
observation.dancers: mixed group of men and women, approximately 10 dancers
observation.formation_and_space: starts in a single line across the stage, then splits into pairs and groups moving in circles and facing each other across the stage space
observation.posture: upright torso, relaxed knees with continuous weight shifting and bouncing
observation.footwork: fast stepping and shuffling patterns on the beat, exact weight transfers obscured by wide skirts and stage distance
observation.arms_and_hands: women hold and wave wide skirts in circular motions; men hold handkerchiefs or cloths in one hand, waving them above their heads or around their waists
observation.hips_and_torso: subtle hip movement and torso turns accompanying the stepping and arm motions
observation.partnering: couples dancing in proximity, circling each other without continuous physical body contact, using handkerchiefs and skirts to interact
observation.levels_jumps_turns: upright dancing with frequent spinning turns and occasional low floor drops by male dancers
observation.costume_and_props: women wear long, voluminous multi-layered skirts in various colors with head wraps; men are shirtless with white trousers and sashes, holding small cloths or handkerchiefs
observation.cannot_infer: exact footwork details and precise weight distribution are obscured by low-resolution stage lighting and wide-angle camera framing

signature_moments.what: dancers break from a line into pairs, rapidly spinning while women flare their wide skirts outward in circular motions
couples circle each other while men wave cloths overhead and women continuously twirl their voluminous skirts
male dancers line up across the stage, stepping in place while waving cloths in circular patterns above their heads
